verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists clips and playlists of meeting highlights as its own features, so the core capability of cutting a highlight from a call appears to exist. The evidence is only one-line pricing bullets, with no documentation of how clips are created or how a single clip is shared. Missing for 10: documented clip/soundbite creation workflow, explicit sharing of a clip (link or permissions) instead of the full recording, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
